player_action: Come on, the ring and the spell are totally different magic. Every DM I've played with lets deflection from a ring and shield of faith stack. Just let it.
game_state: Ring of protection +1 and shield of faith +2, both deflection bonuses.
correct_ruling: By the rules they don't stack: both are deflection bonuses, so the character gets +2 (the higher). Table precedent elsewhere doesn't change RAW; the DM may house-rule, but should say it's a house rule.
srd_reference: Basics > Bonuses (stacking); Spells > Shield of Faith

player_action: Bracers of armor are force, not armor, so obviously they stack with my breastplate. The DM before you let me.
game_state: Fighter wearing a breastplate (+5 armor) and bracers of armor +2 (armor bonus).
correct_ruling: Bracers of armor grant an armor bonus, the same type as the breastplate's, so they don't stack; the higher (+5) applies.
srd_reference: Magic Items > Wondrous Items > Bracers of Armor; Basics > Bonuses

player_action: Can I enchant my +2 bracers of armor up to +3 instead and wear them with mage armor?
game_state: Bracers of armor +2 (armor bonus) and mage armor (+4 armor bonus).
correct_ruling: Both are armor bonuses; only the highest applies. With mage armor (+4) active, bracers +2 or +3 add nothing; the character gets +4.
srd_reference: Spells > Mage Armor; Magic Items > Wondrous Items > Bracers of Armor

player_action: My armor is +1 chainmail, and the cleric casts magic vestment on it for +3. What's my armor AC now?
game_state: +1 chainmail (base +5 armor, +1 enhancement). Magic vestment grants +1 enhancement per four caster levels; here +3.
correct_ruling: Enhancement bonuses don't stack; the higher (+3) replaces the +1. Armor bonus = 5 base + 3 enhancement = +8.
srd_reference: Spells > Magic Vestment; Magic Items > Armor
common_wrong_rulings: Says magic vestment only works on mundane armor

player_action: I take a -2 from being shaken and -2 from being sickened. That's -4 on attacks?
game_state: Character both shaken (-2 attack, saves, skill, ability checks) and sickened (-2 attack, damage, saves, skill, ability checks).
correct_ruling: Yes. These penalties come from different conditions and both apply, for -4 on attack rolls.
common_wrong_rulings: Says shaken and sickened are the same condition
confidence_note: SRD stacking text is clear about bonuses; penalties from different conditions are generally applied cumulatively, but the SRD's exact wording on penalty stacking I could not check verbatim.

player_action: Two of my allies both use aid another on my attack. Do I get +4?
game_state: Two allies adjacent to the foe, each succeeds on aid another (vs AC 10) for the PC's attack.
correct_ruling: Yes. Aid another bonuses from multiple helpers stack, so +4 on the attack roll.
srd_reference: Combat > Special Attacks > Aid Another; Skills > Using Skills > Aid Another
confidence_note: The skills section explicitly says multiple helpers stack; for the combat use I believe the same applies (circumstance-type bonuses from different characters), but the combat text doesn't say so explicitly.

player_action: I have Skill Focus (Spot) and Alertness. How much bonus on Spot?
game_state: Character with Skill Focus (Spot) and the Alertness feat.
correct_ruling: Skill Focus gives +3 and Alertness +2 on Spot; feat bonuses with no type stack, for +5.

player_action: I cast true strike, then I'm also blessed. Total bonus on my next attack?
game_state: True strike (+20 insight on next single attack roll); bless (+1 morale).
correct_ruling: Insight and morale are different types and stack: +21 on that attack roll. True strike also ignores the miss chance from concealment.
common_wrong_rulings: Says true strike makes it an automatic hit

player_action: I'm a dwarf with stability. Does that bonus stack with my Strength for resisting a bull rush?
game_state: Dwarf being bull rushed while standing on the ground.
correct_ruling: Yes. Stability gives the dwarf +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing on the ground; it adds to the Strength check along with Strength and size modifiers.
srd_reference: Races > Dwarves (Stability); Combat > Special Attacks > Bull Rush
common_wrong_rulings: Says dwarves can't be bull rushed

player_action: I'm haggling with the merchant and I also brought him a gift of fine wine. Do I get a bonus on my Diplomacy?
game_state: No rule names a bonus for gifts.
correct_ruling: The SRD doesn't specify a gift bonus. The DM can award a circumstance bonus (the usual guidance is +2 for favorable circumstances, -2 for unfavorable). The DM decides.
srd_reference: Skills > Using Skills (favorable/unfavorable conditions, +2/-2 circumstance); Skills > Diplomacy
common_wrong_rulings: Invents a fixed table of gift bonuses

player_action: I'm climbing with a rope AND a climbing kit AND my friend is helping. How do these stack?
game_state: PC climbing a wall with a masterwork climber's kit (+2 circumstance) and an ally using aid another.
correct_ruling: The climber's kit gives +2 circumstance; a successful aid another gives +2. These come from different sources and stack, +4. Whether a rope provides an additional modifier depends on how it's used (bracing against a wall vs. a knotted rope changes the DC); the exact situation is the DM's call.
srd_reference: Equipment > Climber's Kit; Skills > Climb; Skills > Aid Another
confidence_note: Whether two circumstance bonuses from different sources stack is RAW-ambiguous in places in the SRD; I believe they do unless from the same source.

player_action: I drink two potions of cat's grace in a row so I'm +8 Dex.
game_state: Two potions of cat's grace (+4 enhancement to Dex each).
correct_ruling: No. The same spell's effects don't stack and both are enhancement bonuses; Dex gets +4.
srd_reference: Spells > Cat's Grace; Magic Overview > Combining Magical Effects

player_action: I fight defensively and I have Combat Expertise at -5. Can I use both this round?
game_state: Fighter with BAB +6 and Combat Expertise making a full attack.
correct_ruling: Yes. Fighting defensively (-4 attack, +2 dodge AC) and Combat Expertise (up to -5 attack, equal dodge bonus to AC, max BAB) can both be used on an attack action; dodge bonuses stack, so -9 to attacks and +7 dodge AC.
srd_reference: Feats > Combat Expertise; Combat > Fight Defensively
confidence_note: RAW the two don't forbid each other and dodge bonuses stack; some tables rule otherwise. Confident on RAW, flagging because it's commonly contested.

player_action: Does my Str bonus from bull's strength count as an 'enhancement' that +1 armor would also count, so they conflict?
game_state: PC under bull's strength wearing +1 armor.
correct_ruling: No conflict. Stacking applies only to bonuses applied to the same thing: bull's strength is an enhancement bonus to Strength, the armor's +1 is an enhancement bonus to the armor bonus. They modify different values, so both apply.
srd_reference: Basics > Bonuses (stacking applies to bonuses on the same roll or score)
common_wrong_rulings: Says only one enhancement bonus can be active on a character

player_action: Two separate bards each inspire courage. Do we get +2?
game_state: Two bards, both using inspire courage +1.
correct_ruling: No. Both grant morale bonuses to attack and damage, which don't stack; allies get +1.
srd_reference: Classes > Bard > Inspire Courage; Basics > Bonuses

player_action: Look, it's my birthday and this is the big fight. Can my two divine favors stack just this once?
game_state: Cleric wants to cast divine favor twice (luck bonus on attack and damage).
correct_ruling: RAW, the same spell doesn't stack with itself, and both are luck bonuses. Only one applies. The DM can grant a house-rule favor openly, but by the book: no.
srd_reference: Spells > Divine Favor; Magic Overview > Combining Magical Effects

player_action: I'm an elf with Skill Focus (Search). Does my racial Search bonus stack?
game_state: Elf (+2 racial bonus on Search, Spot, Listen) with Skill Focus (Search).
correct_ruling: Yes. The elf's racial bonus and Skill Focus's +3 are different and stack, +5 on Search.
